desc: Derive and implement iterative traversal to compute parent, depth, weighted root distance, and nearest same-valued ancestor depth with rollback.
Propagate the maximum repeat depth along each root-to-node path and use it to determine the earliest valid start.
Implement tie-breaking for maximum weighted length and minimum number of nodes, including zero-length paths.
Validate against both examples, repeated values, branching trees, zero-length optima, and deep skewed trees.
